_meta.name: Founder Content‑to‑Demand Engine
_meta.description: Retrieves founder content requests, validates data quality, drafts on‑brand content assets, routes for approval, and persists attribution.

nodes.name: Capture & Validate Founder Content
nodes.description: Retrieve synthetic founder content requests and assess data quality.

nodes.name: Qualify & Score Content
nodes.description: Score relevance, brand fit, audience targeting, and data quality for each request.

nodes.name: Verify Qualification & Enforce Policy
nodes.description: Validate the scoring output, enforce policy (e.g., must have brand GUIDELINES), and gate downstream actions.

nodes.name: Draft Content Assets
nodes.description: Generate on‑brand drafts (LinkedIn post, email, carousel outline) with XAI provenance.

nodes.name: Route to Owner & Request Approval
nodes.description: Assign content to the appropriate owner and create an approval request (no external send).

nodes.name: Persist Attribution & Evidence
nodes.description: Save run metrics, content asset metadata, and attribution for dashboards and weekly brief.
